title: tylanthus virgatus
intro: Tylanthus virgatus, commonly known as the 'Bitter Tea Tree', is a plant species in the family Rutaceae. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and aid in digestion. The therapeutic actions of Tylanthus virgatus include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its traditional use in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
